text:
Nina Patel: Heads-up — QuiverHealth dedicated rollout scheduled for Wed 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC (quiet window 02:30–04:00). We need a quick QA sweep, final version pin, and confirm rollback thresholds. I propose pinning runtime v1.12.4 and model bundle quiver-rl-2026-03@sha256:7a9c.
Marta Gonzalez: ack from product. Release notes are updated: https://redwood.in/release/quiver-2026-04-01 — contains feature toggles and data isolation notes. :thumbsup:
Samir Choi: SRE OK but we need to validate KMS rotation won't collide. Quiver's KMS rotation is scheduled 2026-04-02 per their ops calendar, so safe. I'll run a smoke on staging nets.
Jules: Can someone post the exact deploybot command so I can validate the canary flags? Want to ensure canary slices are 10% then 50% if green.
deploybot: deploybot: Release job queued
```
release run --customer quiverhealth --target dedicated --runtime v1.12.4 --bundle quiver-rl-2026-03@sha256:7a9c --canary 10,50 --quiet-window 02:30-04:00 --rollback-window 30m
```
Theo Lang: Ops read: I want these rollback thresholds captured — error rate >1.5% or 95th latency >800ms for two consecutive 5m windows => immediate rollback. Also watch for KV cache miss spike >3x baseline.
Nina Patel: noted. We'll attach those thresholds to the release ticket and to the deploybot run config.
Marta Gonzalez: Product confirms the feature flags default to off for new tenants; Quiver asked to enable externally after validation. We'll run with flags off.
Samir Choi: I kicked off staging smoke now — logs look clean. Small obs: GPU memory usage spikes ~5% with this bundle, but within headroom. I'll keep an eye during canary.
Jules: I'm on standby for the canary validation checks (latency, fuzzy match on generated outputs for their eval set). Will post A/B diff snapshots.
Nina Patel: final approvals? @Samir Choi @Theo Lang @Marta Gonzalez
Samir Choi: +1 from SRE. Staging smoke ✅
Theo Lang: +1 Ops.
Marta Gonzalez: +1 Product.
deploybot: deploybot: OK scheduled — will auto-start at 2026-04-01T03:00:00Z and post updates here. Dry-run passed (canary config validated). :rocket:
Jules: noted. I will run the evaluation harness during canary and post results within 10 minutes of canary start.
Nina Patel: thanks all — posting rollout checklist in the ticket and pinning the runtime/model in the config. If anything changes, tag this thread. :)
